tools.name: morpho_health_check
tools.description: Check the health status of the MCP server and connected services

tools.name: morpho_get_supported_chains
tools.description: List every chain the Morpho MCP serves, by name, with whether Morpho Blue markets, Morpho Vaults (V1 or V2) and Midnight are supported on it. Blue and Vault support come from the Morpho API chain list the read tools use; Midnight support also requires the chain to be accepted by the Midnight tools.

tools.name: morpho_get_token_balance
tools.description: Get token balance and whether the user needs to approve Morpho or the Bundler before writing. Balance and allowances are self-describing TokenAmounts.

tools.name: morpho_simulate_transactions
tools.description: Simulate transactions on the latest block with eth_simulateV1 and check them against the limits of the Morpho action the user is taking, without sending anything. Use mode "preview" for unsigned calls, listing pending approvals or permits in `authorizations`; use mode "final" for calls whose signatu

tools.name: morpho_doc_search
tools.description: Search the Morpho documentation (docs.morpho.org) by semantic similarity. Returns raw search hits; each hit carries the matched text plus metadata (page title, absolute docs.morpho.org url, breadcrumbs, excerpt).

tools.name: morpho_prepare_deposit
tools.description: Prepare a deposit into a Morpho vault. Checks on-chain allowance and returns a ready-to-sign transactions array with approval txs (if needed) followed by the deposit tx. Handles USDT reset-to-zero and DAI non-standard approval.

tools.name: morpho_prepare_withdraw
tools.description: Prepare a withdraw from a Morpho vault. Returns a ready-to-sign transactions array. Supports "max" for full withdrawal. A vault-share approval transaction may come first and is listed in requirements.

tools.name: morpho_prepare_supply
tools.description: Prepare a supply to a Morpho Blue market. Checks on-chain allowance and returns a ready-to-sign transactions array with approval txs (if needed) followed by the supply tx. Handles USDT reset-to-zero and DAI non-standard approval.

tools.name: morpho_prepare_borrow
tools.description: Prepare a borrow on a Morpho Blue market. Returns a ready-to-sign transactions array with the borrow tx. Includes health factor check against existing collateral position. A BlueBundlesV1 authorization transaction may come first in transactions.

tools.name: morpho_prepare_repay
tools.description: Prepare a repay on a Morpho Blue market. Checks on-chain allowance and returns a ready-to-sign transactions array with approval txs (if needed) followed by the repay tx. Supports "max" for full repayment. Handles USDT reset-to-zero and DAI non-standard approval.

tools.name: morpho_prepare_supply_collateral
tools.description: Prepare a supply of collateral tokens to a Morpho Blue market without borrowing. Checks on-chain allowance and returns a ready-to-sign transactions array with approval txs (if needed) followed by the supply collateral tx. Handles USDT reset-to-zero and DAI non-standard approval.

tools.name: morpho_prepare_withdraw_collateral
tools.description: Prepare a withdrawal of collateral tokens from a Morpho Blue market position. Returns a ready-to-sign transactions array. Supports "max" for full collateral withdrawal. Includes health factor check when user has active borrows. A BlueBundlesV1 authorization transaction may come first in transactions

tools.name: morpho_prepare_claim_rewards
tools.description: Fetch a user's claimable Merkl rewards and prepare a single claim transaction against the canonical Merkl Distributor (0x3Ef3D8bA38EBe18DB133cEc108f4D14CE00Dd9Ae). Returns a ready-to-sign transaction; if nothing is claimable, returns an empty transactions array with an info-level warning. No on-chai

tools.name: morpho_prepare_redeem
tools.description: Prepare a share-based redemption from a Morpho Vault V1 or V2. Checks share allowance and supports "max" for the full share balance. A vault-share approval transaction may come first and is listed in requirements.

tools.name: morpho_prepare_redeem_in_kind
tools.description: Prepare an in-kind redemption from a Morpho Vault V1 or V2, exiting through its underlying Blue markets. A vault-share approval transaction may come first and is listed in requirements.

tools.name: morpho_prepare_force_withdraw
tools.description: Prepare a Vault V2 force withdrawal. The SDK selects the vault adapter and deallocates as needed.

tools.name: morpho_prepare_force_redeem
tools.description: Prepare a Vault V2 share redemption after user-directed market deallocations. Each deallocation amount should include a buffer for share-price drift.

tools.name: morpho_prepare_migrate_to_vault_v2
tools.description: Prepare migration of shares from a Vault V1 into a Vault V2 with the same underlying asset. A vault-share approval transaction may come first and is listed in requirements.

tools.name: morpho_prepare_blue_withdraw
tools.description: Prepare a supply-side withdrawal from a Morpho Blue market. Supports "max" for the full supply position. A BlueBundlesV1 authorization transaction may come first in transactions.

tools.name: morpho_prepare_supply_collateral_and_borrow
tools.description: Prepare one transaction that supplies collateral and borrows from a Morpho Blue market, including when the user has no collateral on-chain yet. A BlueBundlesV1 authorization transaction may come first in transactions.

tools.name: morpho_prepare_repay_and_withdraw_collateral
tools.description: Prepare a combined Morpho Blue debt repayment and collateral withdrawal. Supports "max" for full repayment or all collateral. A BlueBundlesV1 authorization transaction may come first in transactions.

tools.name: morpho_prepare_refinance
tools.description: Prepare a full migration of a Morpho Blue borrow position into a destination market with matching loan and collateral tokens. A BlueBundlesV1 authorization transaction may come first in transactions.

tools.name: morpho_prepare_midnight_set_authorization
tools.description: Prepare authorizing or revoking MidnightBundlesV2 on Midnight for the user. The other Midnight prepare tools add the authorization when they need it, so call this only to revoke it or to authorize ahead of time. Returns one unsigned transaction.

tools.name: morpho_get_vault
tools.description: Get one Morpho vault (V1 or V2) by vault selector `<chainId>:<vaultAddress>`.

tools.name: morpho_query_vaults
tools.description: List Morpho vaults (V1 and V2) with net APY, total assets and liquidity in USD, curators, warnings, and `version`. Filter by `chain_ids`, `search`, and other supported fields. Paginate by passing back `cursor` until it is null.

tools.name: morpho_get_vault_positions
tools.description: List a user's Morpho V1 and V2 vault positions with portfolio totals. Paginate by passing back `cursor` until it is null.

tools.name: morpho_query_markets
tools.description: List Morpho Blue markets, filterable by chain, loan token and collateral token. Paginate by passing back `cursor` until it is null.

tools.name: morpho_get_market
tools.description: Get one Morpho Blue market by market selector.

tools.name: morpho_get_market_positions
tools.description: List a user's Morpho Blue market positions, filterable by chain. Paginate by passing back `cursor` until it is null.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.morpho.org" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: morpho_doc_search · Private data: morpho_get_supported_chains, morpho_get_token_balance, morpho_simulate_transactions, morpho_prepare_deposit, morpho_prepare_withdraw, morpho_prepare_supply_collateral, morpho_prepare_withdraw_collateral, morpho_prepare_redeem, morpho_prepare_redeem_in_kind, morpho_prepare_force_withdraw, morpho_prepare_force_redeem, morpho_prepare_migrate_to_vault_v2, morpho_prepare_refinance, morpho_prepare_midnight_take_lend, morpho_prepare_midnight_supply_collateral_take_borrow, morpho_prepare_midnight_supply_collateral, morpho_prepare_midnight_redeem, morpho_get_vault, morpho_get_vault_positions, morpho_query_markets, morpho_midnight_list_user_positions, morpho_midnight_get_offer_group, morpho_midnight_list_user_offer_groups · Public sink: morpho_prepare_withdraw, morpho_prepare_redeem, morpho_prepare_redeem_in_kind, morpho_prepare_force_redeem, morpho_prepare_migrate_to_vault_v2, morpho_midnight_get_book_quote · Destructive: morpho_prepare_deposit, morpho_prepare_supply, morpho_prepare_repay, morpho_prepare_supply_collateral, morpho_midnight_get_book_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: morpho_doc_search · Private data: morpho_get_supported_chains, morpho_get_token_balance, morpho_simulate_transactions, morpho_prepare_deposit, morpho_prepare_withdraw, morpho_prepare_supply_collateral, morpho_prepare_withdraw_collateral, morpho_prepare_redeem, morpho_prepare_redeem_in_kind, morpho_prepare_force_withdraw, morpho_prepare_force_redeem, morpho_prepare_migrate_to_vault_v2, morpho_prepare_refinance, morpho_prepare_midnight_take_lend, morpho_prepare_midnight_supply_collateral_take_borrow, morpho_prepare_midnight_supply_collateral, morpho_prepare_midnight_redeem, morpho_get_vault, morpho_get_vault_positions, morpho_query_markets, morpho_midnight_list_user_positions, morpho_midnight_get_offer_group, morpho_midnight_list_user_offer_groups · Public sink: morpho_prepare_withdraw, morpho_prepare_redeem, morpho_prepare_redeem_in_kind, morpho_prepare_force_redeem, morpho_prepare_migrate_to_vault_v2, morpho_midnight_get_book_quote · Destructive: morpho_prepare_deposit, morpho_prepare_supply, morpho_prepare_repay, morpho_prepare_supply_collateral, morpho_midnight_get_book_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
